objective.title: The Project
objective.description:
Let's "go back" to living!

•   You have {shortMinutes} or {longMinutes} minutes per day on the app
•   Save one of your memories per day
•    You can invite your phone contacts only

After {longMinutes} minutes you have no more excuses, goback. to life. Every midnight the feed is reset, goback. to sharing with no pressure, you only have your close friends here!

<bold>goback. to life</bold>
